Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Event Tech Coordinator (G1) position at MCI Benelux SA. With a strong technical foundation in web development and digital marketing, combined with hands-on experience in building and maintaining WordPress sites, I am confident in my ability to quickly master Cvent and contribute to your team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and Astra. I am comfortable with data analysis, reporting, and troubleshooting, and I have a keen eye for detail. My experience with structured data and technical audits demonstrates my proactive approach to problem-solving.

I am tech-curious, service-minded, and thrive in fast-paced environments. I am eager to apply my skills to coordinate delegate journeys, manage registrations, and ensure seamless event experiences. I am eligible to work in the EU and am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to MCI's global network.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Event Tech Coordinator (G1) position at MCI Benelux SA. With a unique blend of technical expertise in web development and digital marketing, coupled with a passion for creating seamless user experiences, I am confident that I can excel in this role and contribute to your team's success.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in building and maintaining WordPress websites, managing on-page SEO, and creating content that drives organic traffic. I am comfortable with data analysis and reporting, using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to inform decisions. My technical background includes front-end development experience with AngularJS and JavaScript, which gives me a solid foundation for learning Cvent and customizing registration pages with HTML/CSS.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines technology with a focus on the delegate experience. I am tech-curious and service-minded, always thinking about how to make processes smoother and more intuitive. My experience with structured data and technical SEO audits has taught me to anticipate issues before they arise, a skill that will be valuable in troubleshooting pre-event and onsite.

I am highly organized and capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines, as demonstrated by my work on mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page site while implementing advanced SEO and GEO strategies. I am also proficient in Excel, with experience in data management and reporting.

I am eligible to work in the EU and am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch. I am eager to bring my technical skills and proactive mindset to MCI and contribute to creating unforgettable events.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
